verses.sloka: भ्रातरं निहतं दृष्ट्वा शयानं रामनिर्जितम् ।शोकवेगपरीतात्मा विललाप विभीषणः ।। ६.११२.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: bhrātaraṁ nihataṁ dṛṣṭvā śayānaṁ rāmanirjitam ।śokavegaparītātmā vilalāpa vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.112.1 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana, seeing his brother killed and lying in the battlefield, lamented immersed in sorrow.
translations.hindi: इस युद्ध में श्रीरामचन्द्र जी द्वारा चोट खा कर, समरश्लाघी रावण बड़ा कुपित हुआ

verses.sloka: वीर विक्रान्त विख्यात विनीत नयकोविद ।महार्हशयनोपेत किं शेषे ऽद्य हतो भुवि ।। ६.११२.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: vīra vikrānta vikhyāta vinīta nayakovida ।mahārhaśayanopeta kiṁ śeṣe 'dya hato bhuvi ।। 6.112.2 ।।

translations.english: "O valiant, powerful and renowned king! You who were skilled in all fields and in polity, accustomed to a sumptuous bed, why are you lying on ground?"
translations.hindi: बलवान्‌ रावण के दोनों नेत्र क्रोध के मारे धधक उठे और वह घनुष ले उस महासागर में क्रोध में भरा हुआ श्रीरामचन्द्र पर दौड़ा

verses.sloka: विक्षिप्य दीर्घौ निश्चेष्टौ भुजावङ्गदभूषितौ ।मुकुटेनापवृत्तेन भास्कराकारवर्चसा ।। ६.११२.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: vikṣipya dīrghau niśceṣṭau bhujāvaṅgadabhūṣitau ।mukuṭenāpavṛttena bhāskarākāravarcasā ।। 6.112.3 ।।

translations.english: "Decked with armlets, motionless are your arms, broken, knocked down with the crown, radiant like the Sun."
translations.hindi: मेघ जिस तरह आकाश से जलधारा बर्षा कर तालाबों को “भर देते हैं, उसी तरह सहस्रो बार्णो की वर्षा से रावण ने श्रीराम- चन्द्र जी के शरीर को ( वाणों से ) पूर्ण कर दिया

verses.sloka: तदिदं वीर सम्प्राप्तं मया पूर्वं समीरितम् ।काममोहपरीतस्य यत्ते न रुचितं वचः ।। ६.११२.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadidaṁ vīra samprāptaṁ mayā pūrvaṁ samīritam ।kāmamohaparītasya yatte na rucitaṁ vacaḥ ।। 6.112.4 ।।

translations.english: "Hero! That which was predicted by me earlier, which did not find your favour due to your infatuation, has come true."

verses.sloka: यन्न दर्पात् प्रहस्तो वा नेन्द्रजिन्नापरे जनाः ।न कुम्भकर्णो ऽतिरथो नातिकायो नरान्तकः ।न स्वयं त्वममन्येथास्तस्योदर्को ऽयमागतः ।। ६.११२.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: yanna darpāt prahasto vā nendrajinnāpare janāḥ ।na kumbhakarṇo 'tiratho nātikāyo narāntakaḥ ।na svayaṁ tvamamanyethāstasyodarko 'yamāgataḥ ।। 6.112.5 ।।

translations.english: "Either Prahastha or Indrajith or other Rakshasas, or even Kumbhakarna, an exceeding car warrior, nor Atikaya or Naranthaka or you also did not care for my counsel. Its consequence has come now."
translations.hindi: बीयेबान श्रीरामचन्द्र जी र ण में रावण के धनुष से छूटे हुए - चां से पूरित होकर भी, महागिरि की तरह अचल अटल र पत्त्रोत्तररततमः सरग: ११३३: स शरैः शरजालानि वारयन्‌ समरे स्थितः । गभस्तीनिव सूर्यस्य प्रतिजग्राह वीयवान्‌

verses.sloka: गतः सेतुः सुनीतानां गतो धर्मस्य विग्रहः ।गतः सत्त्वस्य सङ्क्षेपः प्रस्तावानां गतिर्गता ।। ६.११२.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: gataḥ setuḥ sunītānāṁ gato dharmasya vigrahaḥ ।gataḥ sattvasya saṅkṣepaḥ prastāvānāṁ gatirgatā ।। 6.112.6 ।।

translations.english: " As this hero, the wielder of weapons has fallen down on ground, the prudent one who was at boundary, disappeared he who was the form of righteousness, departed he who was a repository of might, thrown down and out of sight he, who was praiseworthy for all, lost position. With the hero falling down, it seems the Sun has fallen down, the moon plunged into darkness, fire became extinct, and the enthusiasm of people wasted."
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्डे दोनों बीर श्रीराम और रावण क्रोध में भर, परस्पर एक दूसरे के ऊपर इस प्रकार की बाणवर्षा करने लगे कि, उन बार्णो के छा जाने से समरभूमि में व्याप्त अन्धकार में, वे दोनों एक दूसरे को नहीं देख पाते थे

verses.sloka: आदित्यः पतितो भूमौ मग्नस्तमसि चन्द्रमाः ।। ६.११२.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: ādityaḥ patito bhūmau magnastamasi candramāḥ ।। 6.112.7 ।।

translations.english: " As this hero, the wielder of weapons has fallen down on ground, the prudent one who was at boundary, disappeared he who was the form of righteousness, departed he who was a repository of might, thrown down and out of sight he, who was praiseworthy for all, lost position. With the hero falling down, it seems the Sun has fallen down, the moon plunged into darkness, fire became extinct, and the enthusiasm of people wasted."
translations.hindi: उस समय उस लड़ाई में लक्ष्मण के बड़े भाई श्रीरामचन्द्र जी रक्त से नहाए हूए ऐसे जान पढ़े; मानों वन में फूला हुआ टेसू काः एक बड़ा वृक्ष खड़ा हो

verses.sloka: चित्रभानुः प्रशान्तार्चिर्व्यवसायो निरुद्यमः ।अस्मिन्निपतिते भूमौ वीरे शस्त्रभृतां वरे ।। ६.११२.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: citrabhānuḥ praśāntārcirvyavasāyo nirudyamaḥ ।asminnipatite bhūmau vīre śastrabhṛtāṁ vare ।। 6.112.8 ।।

translations.english: " As this hero, the wielder of weapons has fallen down on ground, the prudent one who was at boundary, disappeared he who was the form of righteousness, departed he who was a repository of might, thrown down and out of sight he, who was praiseworthy for all, lost position. With the hero falling down, it seems the Sun has fallen down, the moon plunged into darkness, fire became extinct, and the enthusiasm of people wasted."

verses.sloka: किं शेषमिव लोकस्य हतवीरस्य साम्प्रतम् ।रणे राक्षसशार्दूले प्रसुप्त इव पांसुषु ।। ६.११२.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: kiṁ śeṣamiva lokasya hatavīrasya sāmpratam ।raṇe rākṣasaśārdūle prasupta iva pāṁsuṣu ।। 6.112.9 ।।

translations.english: "With the tiger among the Rakshasas fallen asleep like this in the dust in the battlefield, strength of the people departed. What is left in this world?"

verses.sloka: धृतिप्रवालः प्रसहाग्र्यपुष्पस्तपोबलः शौर्यनिबद्धमूलः ।रणे महान् राक्षसराजवृक्षः सम्मर्दितो राघवमारुतेन ।। ६.११२.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: dhṛtipravālaḥ prasahāgryapuṣpastapobalaḥ śauryanibaddhamūlaḥ ।raṇe mahān rākṣasarājavṛkṣaḥ sammardito rāghavamārutena ।। 6.112.10 ।।

translations.english: "The great tree in the form of Rakshasa king, with its firmness as leaves, stubbornness as its blossom, austerity as strength, valour as strong roots, was crushed by the tempest of Raghava in the battlefield."
translations.hindi: दशरथनन्दन शूरवीर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने क्रोध में भर अट्टहास कर रावण से कठोर वचन कहे

verses.sloka: तेजोविषाणः कुलवंशवंशः कोपप्रसादापरगात्रहस्तः ।इक्ष्वाकुसिंहावगृहीतदेहः सुप्तः क्षितौ रावणगन्धहस्ती ।। ६.११२.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: tejoviṣāṇaḥ kulavaṁśavaṁśaḥ kopaprasādāparagātrahastaḥ ।ikṣvākusiṁhāvagṛhītadehaḥ suptaḥ kṣitau rāvaṇagandhahastī ।। 6.112.11 ।।

translations.english: "Ravana's prowess as tusks, father and grand fathers' race as back of the body, wrath as lower body and graciousness as proboscis, overthrown by a lion in the shape of Ikshvaku race having killed him he is lying asleep thrown down."
translations.hindi: अरे. राक्षसाधम ! हस लोगों के अनजाने चिवशा खी को तू जनस्थ न से हर लाया । अतएब तू शूरवीर तो नहीं है

verses.sloka: पराक्रमोत्साहविजृम्भितार्चिर्निश्वासधूमः स्वबलप्रतापः ।प्रतापवान् संयति राक्षसाग्निर्निर्वापितो रामपयोधरेण ।। ६.११२.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: parākramotsāhavijṛmbhitārcirniśvāsadhūmaḥ svabalapratāpaḥ ।pratāpavān saṁyati rākṣasāgnirnirvāpito rāmapayodhareṇa ।। 6.112.12 ।।

translations.english: "The prowess and exceeding energy of Ravana as flames, his sighs as smoke, his own strength as heat, endowed with might, that fire of Rakshasa has been extinguished by the rainy cloud in the shape of Rama in the battlefield."
translations.hindi: जंगल में अकेलो ओर दीन बेचारी वैदेही को बरजोरी हर ल्ला कर, तू अपने को बहादुर लगाता है

verses.sloka: सिंहर्क्षलाङ्गूलककुद्विषाणः पराभिजिद्गन्धनगन्धहस्ती ।रक्षोवृषश्चापलकर्णचक्षुः क्षितीश्वरव्याघ्रहतो ऽवसन्नः ।। ६.११२.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: siṁharkṣalāṅgūlakakudviṣāṇaḥ parābhijidgandhanagandhahastī ।rakṣovṛṣaścāpalakarṇacakṣuḥ kṣitīśvaravyāghrahato 'vasannaḥ ।। 6.112.13 ।।

translations.english: "Rakshasas who followed as tails, humps and horns, Ravana the conquerors of enemies, like elephants in pride, animality as ears and eyes, the bull in the form of Rakshasa Ravana was killed by Rama, the master of earth in the form of tiger."

verses.sloka: वदन्तं हेतुमद्वाक्यं परिमृष्टार्थनिश्चयम् ।रामः शोकसमाविष्टमित्युवाच विभीषणम् ।। ६.११२.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: vadantaṁ hetumadvākyaṁ parimṛṣṭārthaniścayam ।rāmaḥ śokasamāviṣṭamityuvāca vibhīṣaṇam ।। 6.112.14 ।।

translations.english: Thus spoke Rama to Vibheeshana, who was overcome with sorrow and speaking with reason, his determined opinion.
translations.hindi: «सान मत्युपुपादाय्‌ रो मिति, साले ॥॥ १४३ i पञ्चोसरशततमः सगः ११३५ अरे मर्यादा तोड़ने वाले ! अरे निलेज्ज ! अरे दुश्चरित्र ! हेकड़ी में आ तू अपनी मौत अपने हाथ से ला कर भी तू अपने को शूरवीर लगाता है !

verses.sloka: नायं विनष्टो निश्चेष्टः समरे चण्डविक्रमः ।अत्युन्नतमहोत्साहः पतितो ऽयमशङ्कितः ।। ६.११२.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: nāyaṁ vinaṣṭo niśceṣṭaḥ samare caṇḍavikramaḥ ।atyunnatamahotsāhaḥ patito 'yamaśaṅkitaḥ ।। 6.112.15 ।।

translations.english: "This Ravana is not destroyed without power in war. He is of terrible prowess, of extraordinary enthusiasm and fought without any fear and fallen."
translations.hindi: वाह ! शूरश्रेष्ठ बलवान्‌ और कुबेर का छोटा भाई होकर भी, तूने यह काम तो सराहनीय और बड़ा भारी किआ ! इससे तेरी यशपताका खूब फहरायगी !! (यह व्यङ.ग्य है)

verses.sloka: नैवं विनष्टाः शोच्यन्ते क्षत्रधर्ममवस्थिताः ।वृद्धिमाशंसमाना ये निपतन्ति रणाजिरे ।। ६.११२.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: naivaṁ vinaṣṭāḥ śocyante kṣatradharmamavasthitāḥ ।vṛddhimāśaṁsamānā ye nipatanti raṇājire ।। 6.112.16 ।।

translations.english: "Those kings who follow duty steadfast, desiring advancement, fearless in the battlefield, who die in that way should not be mourned."
translations.hindi: अभिमान में चूर होकर तूने जो निन्दित ओर अहितकर कमं किआ है, अब उसका फल भी तुमको बहुत बड़ा मिलेगा

verses.sloka: येन सेन्द्रास्त्रयो लोकास्त्रासिता युधि धीमता ।तस्मिन् कालसमायुक्ते न कालः परिशोचितुम् ।। ६.११२.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: yena sendrāstrayo lokāstrāsitā yudhi dhīmatā ।tasmin kālasamāyukte na kālaḥ pariśocitum ।। 6.112.17 ।।

translations.english: "He who is wise, and the three worlds fear him, including Indra, the Lord of gods, when brought under the sway of death according to timespirit, should not be mourned."
translations.hindi: अरे दुमेते ! तू चोर की तरह सीता को हरण करके अपने को शूर समम रहा है, इससे क्या तुमको लाज नहीं आतो ?

verses.sloka: नैकान्तविजयो युद्धे भूतपूर्वः कदाचन ।परैर्वा हन्यते वीरः परान् वा हन्ति संयुगे ।। ६.११२.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: naikāntavijayo yuddhe bhūtapūrvaḥ kadācana ।parairvā hanyate vīraḥ parān vā hanti saṁyuge ।। 6.112.18 ।।

translations.english: "Not only that, in war, he will only will be victorious is not true now or before. Hero may kill the enemy or will be killed by the enemy."
translations.hindi: यदि मेरी उपस्थिति में बरजोरी सीता हरता, तोतू कभी का मेरे बाणों से मारा जाकर अपने भाई खर के पास पहुँच गया । होता

verses.sloka: इयं हि पूर्वैः सन्दिष्टा गतिः क्षत्रियसम्मता ।क्षत्रियो निहतः सङ्ख्ये न शोच्य इति निश्चय ।। ६.११२.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: iyaṁ hi pūrvaiḥ sandiṣṭā gatiḥ kṣatriyasammatā ।kṣatriyo nihataḥ saṅkhye na śocya iti niścaya ।। 6.112.19 ।।

translations.english: "This course has been practised in the past by ancient kings for those killed in war. Warrior killed in war is not to be mourned', is true."

verses.sloka: तदेवं निश्चयं दृष्ट्वा तत्त्वमास्थाय विज्वरः ।यदिहानन्तरं कार्यं कल्प्यं तदनुचिन्तय ।। ६.११२.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: tadevaṁ niścayaṁ dṛṣṭvā tattvamāsthāya vijvaraḥ ।yadihānantaraṁ kāryaṁ kalpyaṁ tadanucintaya ।। 6.112.20 ।।

translations.english: In principle, in that way, decide the action, freed from grief, considering what action is required."

verses.sloka: तमुक्तवाक्यं विक्रान्तं राजपुत्रं विभीषणः ।उवाच शोकसन्तप्तो भ्रातुर्हितमनन्तरम् ।। ६.११२.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamuktavākyaṁ vikrāntaṁ rājaputraṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।uvāca śokasantapto bhrāturhitamanantaram ।। 6.112.21 ।।

translations.english: Having spoken that way by the valiant prince to Vibheeshana, who was immersed in grief, spoke to Rama for the good of his brother.
translations.hindi: जब में तेरी छाती में बाण मार कर तुमे एथिवी पर गिरा द्‌गा; तब तेरी छाती के ऊपर गीध बैठ कर चुभे हुए बाणों के घावों से बहते हुए रक्त को पीबेंगे

verses.sloka: यो ऽयं विमर्देषु न भग्नपूर्वः सुरैः समेतैः सह वासवेन ।भवन्तमासाद्य रणे विभग्नो वेलामिवासाद्य यथा समुद्रः ।। ६.११२.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: yo 'yaṁ vimardeṣu na bhagnapūrvaḥ suraiḥ sametaiḥ saha vāsavena ।bhavantamāsādya raṇe vibhagno velāmivāsādya yathā samudraḥ ।। 6.112.22 ।।

translations.english: "He who has not been defeated in battle by even gods or Indra combined together in a trial of strength has been routed by you like the flow of the ocean divides on reaching the shore."
translations.hindi: आज मेरे बाणों की चोट से मर कर जब तू भूमि पर गिरेगा तब मांसभक्षी गीघ आदि पक्षी तेरी अतड़ियों को बैसे ही ककमोर ऋकमोर खींच गे , जैसे गरुड सर्पो को झकभोर झकझोर क खींचंते है.

verses.sloka: अनेन दत्तानि सुपूजितानि भुक्ताश्च भोगा निभृताश्च भृत्याः ।धनानि मित्रेषु समर्पितानि वैराण्यमित्रेषु च यापितानि ।। ६.११२.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: anena dattāni supūjitāni bhuktāśca bhogā nibhṛtāśca bhṛtyāḥ ।dhanāni mitreṣu samarpitāni vairāṇyamitreṣu ca yāpitāni ।। 6.112.23 ।।

translations.english: "He bestowed gifts to mendicants, nurtured dependents, filled his friends with wealth, and held grudges against enemies and destroyed them."

verses.sloka: एषोहिताग्निश्च महातपाश्च वेदान्तगः कर्मसु चाग्र्यवीर्यः ।एतस्य यत् प्रेतगतस्य कृत्यं तत् कर्तुमिच्छामि तव प्रसादात् ।। ६.११२.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: eṣohitāgniśca mahātapāśca vedāntagaḥ karmasu cāgryavīryaḥ ।etasya yat pretagatasya kṛtyaṁ tat kartumicchāmi tava prasādāt ।। 6.112.24 ।।

translations.english: "He maintained sacrificial fire and practised austerities. He mastered vedas and was even doing rituals. To the foremost brother's departed soul, I desire your permission to do the rituals."
translations.hindi: , जब श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने युद्ध में रावण के वध करने की अभि- लाषा की, तब उनके शरीर का बल, अखबल, पराक्रम ओर मन की प्रसन्नता दूनी हो गई

verses.sloka: स तस्य वाक्यैः करुणैर्महात्मा सम्बोधितः साधु विभीषणेन ।आज्ञापयामास नरेन्द्रसूनुः स्वर्गीयमाधानमदीनसत्त्वः ।। ६.११२.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tasya vākyaiḥ karuṇairmahātmā sambodhitaḥ sādhu vibhīṣaṇena ।ājñāpayāmāsa narendrasūnuḥ svargīyamādhānamadīnasattvaḥ ।। 6.112.25 ।।

translations.english: Duly admonished by those piteous words of Vibhishana, the great-souled son of the lord of men, of undepressed spirit, gave command for the heavenly funeral rites.
translations.hindi: उस समय महातेजा एवं प्रख्यात प हे छाता देवता प्रकट हुए र हा क हुए और उनमें और भा अधिक फुती आ गई

verses.sloka: मरणान्तानि वैराणि निर्वृत्तं नः प्रयोजनम् ।क्रियतामस्य संस्कारो ममाप्येष यथा तव ।। ६.११२.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: maraṇāntāni vairāṇi nirvṛttaṁ naḥ prayojanam ।kriyatāmasya saṁskāro mamāpyeṣa yathā tava ।। 6.112.26 ।।

translations.english: 'Enmities end with death; our purpose is accomplished. Let his funeral rites now be performed — this is now my duty even as it is yours.'
translations.hindi: तब राक्षसा के मारने वाले श्रीग्घुनाथ जी अपने में इन शुभ लक्षणों को देख कर, फिर रावण को बाणों से पीड़ित करने लगे

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे द्वादशोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। ११२ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe dvādaśottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 112 ।।
